description:
Technical SEO check of one page (a domain's homepage, or `url`): meta tags, JSON-LD types, headings, robots.txt (sitemaps, AI crawlers blocked), /llms.txt, bot protection, and graded Core Web Vitals (PageSpeed Insights mobile + desktop, real-user CrUX).

Billing: 2¢ per page after 3 free pages a day; a page already audited today (incl. the PSI re-poll) or that didn't load is free. 30/hour per host.

When to call: one page's technical health or Core Web Vitals. Whole site: crawl_site (the Site Audit, 1¢ per 10 pages). Not the citation audit (get_audit).

Timing: ~10 s. A PSI strategy still "pending": call again after pagespeed_retry_after_seconds (free; waits up to 38 s). Cached 10 min.

Returns: { url, final_url, redirected, response_status, fetch_error, meta, schema_types, headings, robots: { found, status, sitemaps, ai_crawlers: { allowed, blocked, fix } | null }, llms_txt, pagespeed: { mobile, desktop } | null, cwv_summary?, pagespeed_note?, field_data?, bot_protection?, billing, latest_crawl?, suggested_next, next_step }. Each strategy: { status: ok|error|pending, score (0–100), lcpSec, inpMs, clsUnitless, fcpSec, ttfbSec, tbtMs, field, grades }; grades rate each metric good|needs_improvement|poor, core_web_vitals pass|fail|null (field data only). Lab = one Lighthouse run; field = real-user p75. bot_protection { verdict: checker_refused|ai_blocked|verifies_bots, note, fix? }: relay its note.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. "linear.app". The homepage is fetched unless `url` is set.

include_pagespeed.description: Default true. false skips PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals for a fast meta + schema + robots check.

refresh_pagespeed.description: Default false. true skips cached Core Web Vitals and measures again, e.g. to verify a performance fix.

url.description: Optional exact URL to fetch instead of the homepage, e.g. https://example.com/llms.txt. Fetched as given.

name: run_technical_audit
title: Run a technical SEO check on one page
